caption: The drawing consists of a pencil sketch on a beige background with three separate views of an object. The main section in the center displays a front view of a wall-mounted fixture with a vertically oriented, shield-shaped backplate, rounded at the top and bottom and narrowing in the middle. A circular element is depicted within the upper portion of the backplate, and a round dish-like component protrudes from its center, supported by a grooved, vertical element. Below the dish, a small attachment is present at the lower end of the vertical support. To the lower left, a smaller side elevation view shows the object’s profile, depicting the curving structure of the backplate and the protrusion of the dish and support in side view. To the lower right, a top-down view presents the circular dish and the central vertical support directly from above, revealing the circular geometry. All objects and lines are rendered in shades of grey graphite pencil, with subtle shading to suggest three-dimensional form. There is no additional coloration besides the pencil on the beige paper. The name "FRANCIS LAW DURAND" appears in the lower right corner, and notations “SCALE OF DETAILS” are present beneath the two smaller views.
title: Wall Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
